headline: ‘Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma’ Makes a Case For Embracing Beloved Problematic Films
context: Our film critic Alissa Wilkinson reviews “Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma,” dissecting its argument not to discard your favorite films that may not have aged well.
